english.headline: Your record shouldn’t define your future.
english.subheadline: Find out what record-clearing options may be available to you and get a clear next step.
english.targetAudience: People with criminal records who may be interested in clearing, sealing, or otherwise addressing eligible records, especially individuals who face barriers to employment, housing, education, licensing, or other opportunities because of their record. The program is intended to reach people who need a simple, affordable way to understand their options and next steps, including those who may need referral to legal aid or an attorney when self-help is not appropriate.
english.primaryActionLabel: Find out what record-clearing options may be available to you and get a clear next step. [ Start free ]
english.participantSupportCopy: Need help using the program? Fresh Start Network can assist with screening, required information, next steps, and referrals. If your situation requires legal advice or representation, we can help connect you with legal-aid or attorney resources. Please use approved support channels for any sensitive information.
english.organizationDescription: Fresh Start Network helps people understand and navigate opportunities to move forward after involvement with the criminal legal system. Through this program, participants can explore record-clearing options, receive plain-language guidance, and connect with additional support when their situation requires legal assistance.
